digest.component_or_area: bridge CLI and Python operations surface
propositions: One canonical `rebar bridge` surface replaces fragmented Jira-specific operator commands with provider-neutral setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, and resume verbs
Argument-less `reconcile` remains non-mutating dry-run while argument-less `bridge sync` is the canonical mutating command, preserving legacy defaults
Canonical exit codes are 0, 1, and 2 with explicit compatibility adapters translating historical 3, 4, and 75 codes for legacy workflows
Bridge operations are runner-neutral across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments using shared Python core with thin provider-specific declarative wrappers
Python core in src/rebar/_store/push.py owns tickets-branch CAS delivery, retry, and commit semantics; no workflow-local retry loops remain
Pause state is remote-persisted with reason text and safe for mixed-version fleet readers; core operations require no external `gh` CLI dependency
